name: Sandra Kim
segment: Long-tail · Pro tier · pays personally or via team budget
goals: Digitize manual warehouse intake process without involving IT
Build a real-time shipment tracking dashboard for customers
Automate SLA breach alerts for the operations team
communication_style: Process-oriented, describes workflows step-by-step, non-technical, wants things to work without maintenance
pain_points: Warehouse staff use paper forms, data entry takes 3 hours daily
Customers call to check shipment status, no self-service tracking
SLA breaches discovered reactively, always firefighting
sample_prompts: Build a mobile-friendly warehouse intake form that scans barcodes and updates our inventory automatically
Create a customer-facing shipment tracking portal showing real-time delivery status from our carrier
Build an SLA monitoring dashboard that sends Slack alerts when a shipment is at risk of being late
